Which School District 42 schools serve Central Meadows in Pitt Meadows?

Public schools serving or located near Central Meadows include Pitt Meadows Elementary (11941 Harris Rd, English and Early French Immersion K-7), Davie Jones Elementary (12030 Blakely Rd, K-7), and Pitt Meadows Secondary (19438 116B Ave, English and French Immersion 8-12). Always verify exact street-address catchment boundaries using the official School District 42 (Maple Ridge – Pitt Meadows) locator before removing subjects.
What parks, trails, and recreation facilities are near Central Meadows?

How are roads, West Coast Express access, and commuting in Central Meadows?

Primary commuter and road corridors serving Central Meadows include Harris Road, Ford Road, Hammond Road, Blakely Road, Lougheed Highway (Hwy 7), and Pitt Meadows West Coast Express Station (12185 Harris Rd), connecting residents to Lougheed Highway (Hwy 7), Dewdney Trunk Road, the Golden Ears Bridge, and TransLink RapidBus (R3) and West Coast Express commuter rail stations.

What are the 2021 Statistics Canada Census demographics for Central Meadows?
